summary: Acer Aspire 5 14 (Model: A514-54G-F4JH) with Intel Core i7-1165G7 processor, 16 GB RAM, and NVIDIA GeForce MX350 graphics. The laptop experiences thermal throttling issues due to inadequate cooling system.
